authorization.scope: One separate exact-upstream missing-value compatibility experiment.

objective: Complete two reproducible label-free MapLight fixed-feature roots by preserving the narrowly diagnosed RDKit charge-descriptor NaNs exactly for pinned CatBoost while retaining every other signed-int8, row, feature, environment, and firewall rule.
hypothesis: The exact upstream fixed representation is reproducible on every frozen shadow row when NaN is allowed only in the four Gasteiger charge-extrema descriptor columns and is passed unchanged to CatBoost 1.2.1, whose pinned default missing-value mode is Min.

inheritance.rule: Every clause in the hash-bound signed-int8 compatibility contract remains normative unless its exact JSON pointer appears below.
inheritance.model_authority: After two matching roots pass review, only the already frozen CatBoost representation candidates R1 through R5 may fit. The ExtraTrees E1 diagnostic remains unexecuted because scikit-learn 1.3.0 rejects NaN. No imputed estimator control or replacement candidate is authorized.

sole_scientific_change.preservation_rule: Retain each permitted NaN byte-for-byte in float64 arrays. Do not impute, replace, add a missingness indicator, delete a descriptor, delete a row, alter a structure, or add element parameters.
sole_scientific_change.rejection_rule: Reject every infinity, every NaN outside the four exact columns, and every non-finite value in binary Morgan, Morgan count, Avalon count, or ErG.

consumer_rule.nan_mode_parameter: Do not set nan_mode explicitly; bind and receipt the resolved pinned default Min to preserve upstream parameter behavior.
consumer_rule.required_pre_fit_probe: A synthetic, label-independent capability probe must show that the exact environment accepts float64 NaN and emits finite probabilities with resolved nan_mode Min.
consumer_rule.extra_trees: Not authorized on this exact matrix; no imputation or feature deletion may be introduced to make it run.

execution.repeat_gate: Require feature_rows.csv and all five NPY files to be byte-identical across builds, including NaN payload bytes. Validate exact logical filenames, NPY v1.0, dimensions, dtypes, C order, signed-int8 overflow statistics, allowed-NaN masks and counts, source hashes, and row alignment before any target path is available.

receipt_additions.failure_rule: Record the safe block, row index, raw hash, descriptor index and name when applicable; never record raw structure text. Remove staging before one immutable failure receipt.

firewall.allowed_inputs: The inherited frozen label-free shadow rows, shadow manifest, MapLight source, compatible environment, signed-int8 parity, prior blockers, this contract, and its tracked diagnosis receipt only.
firewall.forbidden: Measurement or target files, public-test rows or labels, scientific model fitting, predictions, metrics, GIN weights, challenge assumptions, imputation, row deletion, descriptor deletion, or custom charge parameters.

acceptance: The signed-int8 compatibility parity remains exact and unchanged.
Both real builds contain all 30,038 row-aligned rows and five declared arrays, with permitted NaN only in the exact four descriptor columns and exact diagnosed counts.
Both row files and all ten corresponding array files are byte-identical across builds.
The synthetic CatBoost capability probe passes with finite probabilities and resolved nan_mode Min.
Every source, environment, row, array, overflow, non-finite, resource, accounting, and output receipt passes review.
No target, scientific fit, prediction, metric, GIN, challenge, or public-test operation occurs before the feature gate.
stopping_rules: Stop on any source, environment, revision, row, hash, schema, dimension, dtype, order, resource, or repeat mismatch.
Stop on any NaN outside descriptor indices 39, 41, 43, and 45.
Stop if the permitted NaN mask or counts differ across independent builds.
Stop if any scientific change beyond exact preservation of the diagnosed NaNs is required.
Stop after feature review if pinned CatBoost does not accept the unchanged matrix with resolved nan_mode Min.
Preserve a precise blocker; do not repair after any model or metric result.
next_gate: Review and merge this result-blind authorization, then implement the smallest direct overlay on the frozen signed-int8 runner. Generate build 1 only after code review; generate build 2 only after build-1 artifact review; fit no scientific model until both roots pass the byte gate.
claim_boundary: This experiment tests exact upstream missing-value compatibility in a pinned local environment. It does not establish the undocumented historical runtime, predictive value, public-test performance, challenge transfer, or superiority.
